lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units. Blob diameter decreases and spatial density increases in the transition from the mid-flank toward the anterior gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the primary blobs to form a grid-like configuration along the mid-lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift—bright on the dorsal edge and shadowed on the ventral edge—indicating structural ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin exhibits a unique curvilinear, swirling white pattern near the insertion point, distinct from the uniform circular blobs found elsewhere.
